method: Chromium SwiftShader software at 480×320 DPR1, synchronized gl.finish+readPixels render times; 14 hot samples per condition, alternating before/after or on/off order. Same camera/date/profile in main pairs. Component switches only for cost inspection, never production fallbacks. Campaign run alone without native walk or capture recording. Software scheduling remains noisy; no physical GPU/Android FPS claim. Fog toggle isolates the two local mist meshes; lantern measurement uses a close-up at an actual installed fixture, with active fixture counts recorded. Wind toggle only isolates shader mean, not the complete forest response-bank update. Discharge toggle measures receiver shading, not an entire rare bolt frame.
